REGULATION II OF 1979
REGULATION II OF 1979
CRIMINAL LAW (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) (APPLICATION TO THE PROVINCIALLY
ADMINISTERED TRIBAL AREAS OF BALUCHISTAN) REGULATION, 1979
A Regulation to apply the Criminal Law (Special Provisions) Ordinance,
1968 (West Pakistan Ordinance No. II of 1968), to the Provincially Administered
Tribal Areas of Baluchistan
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, 16th October 1979]
No. D.497-F.III/79 -The following
Regulation made by the President on the 15th October 1979, is hereby published
for general information:-
Whereas it is expedient to apply
the Criminal Law (Special Provisions) Ordinance, 1968 (West Pakistan Ordinance
No. II of 1968), to the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of Baluchistan ;
Now, therefore, in pursuance of
the Proclamation of the fifth day of July 1977, read with the Laws (Continuance
in Force) Order, 1977 (C. M. L. A. Order No. 1 of 1977), and in exercise of all
powers enabling him in that behalf, the President is pleased to make the
following regulation :-
1. Short title, extent and commencement.-(1) This Regulation may be
called the Criminal Law (Special Provisions) (Application to the Provincially
Administered Tribal Areas of Baluchistan) Regulation, 1979.
(2) It extends to the whole of
the Provincially Administered Tribal Area of Baluchistan.
(3) It shall come into force on
the fifteenth day of October, 1979.
2. Application of West Pakistan Ordinance No. II of 1968 to the Tribal
Areas.-The provisions of the Criminal Law (Special Provisions) Ordinance,
1968 (West Pakistan Ordinance No. II of 1968), shall apply to the whole of the
Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of Baluchistan subject to the modi fication
that references therein to "Deputy Commissioner" and "Assistant
Commissioner" shall be construed as reference to "Political
Agent" and "Assistant Political Agent" respectively.
3. Repeal.-The Frontier Crimes Regulation, 1901 (Regulation III of
1901), is hereby repealed.
4. Transfer of pending cases.-All criminal cases which were pending
under the Frontier Crimes Regulation, 1901 (Regulation III of 1901), imme diately
before the commencement of this Regulation in the Provincially Administered
Tribal Areas of Baluchistan shall on such commencement, stand transferred to a
Tribunal constituted for the purpose under the Criminal Law (Special
Provisions) Ordinance, 1968 (West Pakistan Ordinance No. II of 1968).
